title: Seasonal Systems Research Lead & Algorithms Instructor
description: We are seeking a Seasonal Systems Research Lead & Algorithms Instructor to oversee our advanced software quality control, software process improvement initiatives, and guide student research teams. In this high-level seasonal role, you will be responsible for lecturing on basic programming, data structures, algorithms, and discrete mathematics. You will lead teams in systems-level programming using C, C++, and Java, and supervise projects involving GPU performance optimizations, regression test selection, and blockchain for IoT applications. The ideal candidate must have extensive university teaching experience (at the assistant professor or teaching assistant level) and a strong background in software team leadership.
requirements: 10+ years of university teaching assistantship, research assistantship, or assistant professorship in computer science and software engineering.
Proven experience as a Software Team Leader or Research Project Director leading software engineering teams.
Deep technical expertise in C, C++, and Java programming, systems architecture, and memory performance optimization.
Demonstrated knowledge in software quality control automation, software process improvement, regression test selection, and algorithms / data structures instruction.
Bilingual proficiency in both English and Arabic with strong academic writing and presentation skills.
benefits: Access to research labs, GPU clusters, and institutional databases
Opportunity to lead high-impact public-sector research projects
